title: How to dispense an Espaço Prelúdio prescription · Guide for pharmacies
metaDescription: Quick guide for pharmacies: how to fill a digital prescription issued by Espaço Prelúdio. No registration, in 30 seconds.

intro.h1: How to dispense an Espaço Prelúdio prescription
intro.lead: No pharmacy registration. No login. In 30 seconds. The system tracks the remaining balance across every pharmacy that fills the same prescription.

s1.title: Scan the QR code or open the link
s1.body: The patient shows the link on their phone or a printed PDF with QR code. Point your camera at it, or paste the link into the pharmacy's browser. You don't need to install anything or create an account.

s2.title: Check authenticity
s2.bodyHtml: The page shows "Authentic digital prescription" in green if the document is valid. You see the patient, the issuing professional (CRM/CRP/RQE), signature date and a 30-day clinical validity. To revalidate the ICP-Brasil signature, download the PDF and open it at the ITI gov.br Verifier.

s3.title: Check the remaining balance
s3.bodyHtml: The "Dispensing" block shows how many units have already been filled at other pharmacies and how many remain. If status is "PENDING" or "PARTIAL", there is balance available. "COMPLETE", "EXPIRED" or blocked: do not dispense — ask the prescriber for a new prescription.

s4.title: Register the dispensing
s4.bodyHtml: Click "I'm a pharmacist — register dispensing". Provide your CRF (with state code), full name, pharmacy CNPJ, pharmacy name and the quantity you'll fill now. Check "Save this pharmacy's data in this browser" so it will be pre-filled next time.

s5.title: Fill it and follow your normal workflow
s5.body: After registering, the system updates the balance instantly. Record the sale in the pharmacy POS per your usual procedure (including SNGPC for controlled substances). The prescriber receives an automatic email notification that dispensing occurred.

q1.q: Do I need to register my pharmacy?
q1.a: No. The system works without prior registration. You identify yourself at the moment of dispensing by providing your CRF + CNPJ. Everything is audited.

q2.a: Yes. It is signed with an ICP-Brasil A1 certificate or equivalent, complying with Law 13.787/2018, CFM Resolution 2.299/2021 and ANVISA RDC 471/2021. The digital signature can be validated at the ITI gov.br Verifier.

q3.q: Can the patient fill it at more than one pharmacy?
q3.a: Yes, within the prescribed balance. Example: prescription for 2 boxes — the patient fills 1 box at pharmacy A today, then 1 box at pharmacy B tomorrow. The system prevents the balance from being exceeded.

q4.q: How long is the prescription valid?
q4.a: 30 days from the signature date, per RDC 471/2021 (Special Control Prescription form). After that, the system automatically blocks new dispensing.

q5.q: What if I suspect fraud (tampered link, suspicious data)?
q5.a: Do not dispense. Check the history on the page: previous dispensings appear with the pharmacist's CNPJ and CRF. If in doubt, contact the prescriber directly — phone number is on the PDF — or file a report with your local CRF/Health Surveillance.

q6.q: Who operates Espaço Prelúdio? Can I request support?
q6.aHtml: It is a telehealth platform for psychologists and psychiatrists. For support, write to contato@espacopreludio.com.br.
